tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every surface sits on it.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, notices; fields sit on it.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, search results, the checkout panel.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Sheets, modals, the email card.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills.

tokens.name: bg-track
tokens.usage: Tracks, timeline future, sheet handle.

tokens.name: bg-section
tokens.usage: Landing alternate sections.

tokens.name: bg-deep
tokens.usage: Landing deepest band, footer.

tokens.name: bg-field
tokens.usage: Fields inside Paddle’s frame (approximation only; Paddle draws them).

tokens.name: bg-frame
tokens.usage: The frame around boards and emails. Never inside the product.

tokens.name: exo-field-bg
tokens.usage: Text field fill (R42). Text in fg-primary on it.

tokens.name: fg-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, primary text, primary button fill, field text. On bg-base, bg-panel, bg-raised and exo-field-bg (15.9–16.4:1 dark, 16.7–17.7:1 light).

tokens.name: fg-body
tokens.usage: Long reading text in the note reader. On bg-base and bg-panel (11.2–11.6:1 dark, 10.7–11.3:1 light).

tokens.name: fg-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions, ledes, secondary copy. On bg-base and bg-panel (7.2–7.5:1 dark, 5.4–5.7:1 light).

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Labels and metadata, field labels. On bg-panel 4.9:1 dark, 4.6:1 light. Flag: on bg-base in light it is 4.3:1, just under AA (locked value kept): there, use fg-secondary for anything under 12 px.

tokens.name: fg-placeholder
tokens.usage: Field placeholder and the hint line. On exo-field-bg and bg-panel (4.9–5.0:1 dark, 4.6–4.9:1 light).

tokens.name: fg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Faint labels, disabled, off states. Decorative only: below 4.5:1 on purpose; never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: fg-dim-struck
tokens.usage: Struck, superseded text (always with the strike line).

tokens.name: fg-footer
tokens.usage: Landing and email footer. Flag: 3.5–3.7:1 on the grounds, below AA for its 12 px size (locked value kept; a darker or lighter step is a proposal for Alex).

tokens.name: exo-amber
tokens.usage: THE accent: lights only what is live, retrieved or current. Lit dots, focus rings, current chip, the writing E. Never decoration. As text only at 24 px+ in light (4.0–4.3:1); smaller amber text uses exo-amber-text.

tokens.name: exo-amber-text
tokens.usage: Amber as small text (“Paying now”, friend-price caps). On bg-panel 10.5:1 dark, 4.8:1 light; on bg-base light 4.5:1.

tokens.name: exo-phosphor
tokens.usage: The bright amber. In light it appears only as the halo around a lit note or a lit E, never as a fill.

tokens.name: exo-glow
tokens.usage: Glow around a lit note.

tokens.name: exo-tint
tokens.usage: Lit tile background; amber button hover fill.

tokens.name: exo-amber-line
tokens.usage: “Current” chip outline, amber button border.

tokens.name: exo-focus-ring
tokens.usage: The soft outer ring of keyboard focus, outside the solid exo-amber ring.

tokens.name: selection-bg
tokens.usage: Selected text background (::selection) on every surface. Amber because a selection is current.

tokens.name: selection-fg
tokens.usage: Selected text colour: ink on selection-bg (8.6:1 dark, 11:1 light).

tokens.name: exo-rule
tokens.usage: Section rules, row dividers.

tokens.name: exo-border-card
tokens.usage: Card and panel borders.

tokens.name: exo-border-input
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, secondary buttons at rest.

tokens.name: exo-border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover on bordered controls (3:1 against the ground).

tokens.name: shadow-color
tokens.usage: The colour inside shadow-pop.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modals and the Paddle overlay.

tokens.name: scrim-soft
tokens.usage: Landing overlays.

styles.name: price-hero
styles.usage: The one big price on the checkout page. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: A page’s one heading (22 px on phone). Balanced wrap.

styles.name: block-title
styles.usage: The title of a state block or modal step.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat tile value (17 px on phone).

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Kept what changed, why, and what replaced it.
styles.usage: Paragraphs in the note reader, in fg-body.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Exomem, billed monthly by Paddle. Cancel any time.
styles.usage: Default UI text and field values.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: This usually takes a few seconds.

styles.name: field-line
styles.usage: The hint and error line under a field.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, button text in panels, in fg-muted (labels) or on fills.

styles.name: button-page
styles.usage: A page’s main action (46–48 px tall).

styles.name: caps
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker labels. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: section-caps
styles.usage: Section labels in the note reader, uppercase, fg-muted.

tokens.name: r-tag
tokens.usage: Tags, status chips, type chips, ghost buttons.

tokens.name: r-ctl
tokens.usage: Buttons and filter chips.

tokens.name: r-field
tokens.usage: Text fields (R42 field spec), the zoom stack, page-size buttons.

tokens.name: r-card
tokens.usage: Cards, notices, observation blocks, the switch row.

tokens.name: r-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the E tile.

tokens.name: r-sheet
tokens.usage: Phone sheet top corners.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers and floating pills only. Cards have borders, not shadows.

opacity.note: Graph opacities are part of the look. Light mode uses graph-node 0.3 and graph-link 0.12 (moving ink matches dark mode’s contrast, not its opacity).

tokens.name: graph-node
tokens.usage: A resting note (light 0.3).

tokens.name: graph-hub
tokens.usage: A busy note.

tokens.name: graph-link
tokens.usage: A plain link (light 0.12).

tokens.name: graph-dim
tokens.usage: Everything else while one note is hovered (landing).

tokens.name: graph-wake
tokens.usage: Notes near the pointer.

tokens.name: graph-lit-link
tokens.usage: Links of the lit note.

tokens.name: we-faint
tokens.usage: Unwritten dots of the writing E while it is a meter.

duration.note: Every ambient and transition effect is off under reduced motion.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Hover colour and border changes.

tokens.name: dur-state
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity state changes, glow on and off.

tokens.name: dur-swap
tokens.usage: Content cross-fades (Swap, Crossfade) and Collapse.

tokens.name: dur-sheet
tokens.usage: Phone sheet open and close.

tokens.name: dur-move
tokens.usage: Camera and layout moves.

tokens.name: dur-write
tokens.usage: The writing E moving to its next number.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Camera, sheet, layout moves, the writing E, Collapse.

tokens.name: ease-out-expo
tokens.usage: Entrances: content fading up in.
